% makeidx's index, with test-staleaux-ind.ind beside the document from an
% earlier build that loaded hyperref: its \hyperpage is undefined now. The
% build sorts the index in its own folder, so the page's index is the
% document's, and the build gives no error.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{makeidx}
\makeindex
\begin{document}
An apple\index{Apple} and a pear\index{Pear}.
\printindex
\end{document}
